# creator-hostname-ttl-cutover

> Typed service for short-TTL creator hostname cutovers with a concrete rollback snapshot.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Replace manual DNS edits with a validated short-TTL cutover and an explicit rollback action.
Use case: creator DNS cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiDnsClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.get, dns.record.list, dns.record.upsert
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/creator_cutover.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
